sources.label: Form 10-Q for the quarter ended September 30, 2025 (SEC EDGAR)

takeaways.text: Analog revenue rose 16% to $3.73B — 79% of all sales — while Embedded Processing grew 9% to $709M and Other rose 11% to $304M.
takeaways.title: Analog did the lifting

takeaways.text: Gross margin slipped to 57.4% from 59.6% a year ago, but the revenue growth still lifted operating profit 7% to $1.66B.
takeaways.title: Margins eased

takeaways.text: TI returned $1,355M in the quarter — $1,236M of dividends and $119M of buybacks — against $1,068M of free cash flow.
takeaways.title: Cash returned to owners

verdict: Texas Instruments grew revenue 14% to $4.74B as Analog sales rose 16%, and operating profit climbed 7% — though restructuring charges and a bigger tax bill held net income flat at $1.36B.
